decision: RETIRE K1 AS UNTESTED, NOT REFUTED: the registration is withdrawn before a grant because its endpoint cannot produce an admissible comparison on the shipping build, and the precision deficit it leaves is unowned until a fresh registration names it.
basis: On 0.15.0 all eighteen gold pairs are asserted on every K1 seed: recall is 1.000 and false negatives are zero.
The late structure is present rather than absent: late-group F1 is 0.129032-0.134831 on 0.15.0, against 0.000 on every 0.9.0 seed.
The whole -0.623961 gap is carried by false assertions, so a larger served set can only lower precision.
The registered endpoint therefore has no range to detect the success of its own intervention.
not: a refutation of the K1 hypothesis, or evidence that incremental structure does not matter
a null result: no cell was opened and no criterion was read
a re-scoring of the 0.9.0 campaign, the 0.15.0 replication or any verdict
an authorisation for an engine change, a seed, a cell or a successor registration
successor: The precision question needs a new registration named for the mechanism it would change (rule 8), not a K1 row wearing a new hypothesis. Which constraint, if any, succeeds this one is the owner's decision.
